changeSet.author: Ahmet_Calik
changeSet.comment: Backfill the shipping_fee on existing invoices based on the associated order's shipping method
changeSet.sql: UPDATE public.invoice i SET shipping_fee = sm.shipping_price FROM public.orders o JOIN public.shipping_method sm ON o.shipping_method_id = sm.id WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND (i.shipping_fee IS NULL OR i.shipping_fee = 0.00);
